Monica — thanks for the context. I reviewed GreenEdge_MSA_Redlines_v3.docx and drafted proposed language below; attaching markup changes in-line in the doc (see version v4). Key points:

- SLA: propose 5 business days as default, 3 business days for joint press/written announcements when both parties provide finalized assets. We can accept 30 calendar days only for complex trademark clearance requests, not for standard approvals.

- Anonymized metrics: allow aggregate metrics (e.g., "X% improvement" without naming customers) for case studies; require express consent for named quotes or screenshots of GreenEdge dashboards.
